name: missing-tests-should-trigger-review-rejection
description: Dev intentionally skips tests; Reed must request changes rather than approving.

story.title: Export transactions to CSV
story.description: As an accountant, I want to export transactions to CSV so that I can reconcile them in spreadsheet software.
acceptance_criteria: Export includes date, amount, description, and transaction type.
Export only includes transactions within the selected date range.
User receives a validation message if no transactions match the filter.
constraints: Reuse the existing reporting filter controls.
Do not introduce a background job for this first version.
